subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add official model/session reconcile-reset CLI surfaces, and if so should they report only by default or also clear explicit session, agent, and auth pins under scoped flags?
rationale: The behavior affects persisted session state, explicit user model/auth choices, agent-level overrides, generated model catalog state, provider routing, and upgrade compatibility, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent product semantics.

options.title: Add dry-run plus scoped reset
options.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear them.

options.title: Keep to diagnostics and doctor
options.body: Improve status, doctor, and config validation warnings while leaving runtime precedence and explicit pins unchanged.

options.title: Change precedence or reset defaults
options.body: Make resets or default-model changes automatically clear or override existing pins, accepting the compatibility impact for durable selections.

recommendation.title: Add dry-run plus scoped reset
recommendation.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear them.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed history across model command, status, session helper, and live model inference surfaces involved in this product choice.
